suite: Free camera during actual hinge playback
host: Offline lab with production WebGL renderer, classic UV Worker, real CDP mouse input

cases.name: DPR 1: hinge path defaults to manual mode in UI and renderer
DPR 1: actual play advances geometry while preserving the whole camera
DPR 1: orbit drag during play changes yaw/pitch and survives later frames
DPR 1: right-button pan during play changes target without snap-back
DPR 1: wheel zoom during play remains exactly where the user leaves it
DPR 1: pause/resume and reverse playback never reset the manual camera
DPR 1: forward and reverse loop boundaries keep the camera
DPR 1: scrubbing all stages and switching scope/path never performs an implicit fit
DPR 1: opt-in follow starts immediately when paused, not only at next frame
DPR 1: manual orbit interrupts opt-in follow, updates checkbox and keeps playback running
DPR 1: manual pan interrupts opt-in follow, updates checkbox and keeps playback running
DPR 1: manual zoom interrupts opt-in follow, updates checkbox and keeps playback running
DPR 1: late enabled UI props cannot re-enable follow after a gesture
DPR 1: fit current selection is one-shot, keeps orbit orientation and does not pause play
DPR 1: 3D/UV view buttons fit once and hand control straight back to the user
DPR 1: held pointer suspends follow and cancellation never re-enables it
DPR 1: viewport resizing changes projection size, not camera pose
DPR 1: re-solving UV for the same source mesh retains the manual camera
WebGL context recovery reuploads buffers without resetting the manual camera
DPR 1: source/UV endpoints and real WebGL drawing are unchanged
